translate_en|mods/PrawnsPryOpen/42/media: Nailed on from the other side: -%1 percentage points
Hits needed to shift the panel: %1
Very loud - splintering wood carries a long way
Quieter than prying, but still audible

OFF by default: barricades on player-built doors, windows and walls show no option, matching the way this mod leaves player-built locks alone. <LINE> ON: they can be torn off like any other barricade. This is the base-raiding case, so it is a deliberate server decision. <LINE> Barricades on ordinary world doors and windows are always allowed either way.
Barricade: success chance per Strength point (%%)

Success chance of one barricade attempt is Strength x this value. <LINE> Default 12 means Strength 5 = 60%%, Strength 9 and above always succeeds on planks. <LINE> The result is always clamped to 5-100%%.
Barricade: log what the menu sees

Diagnostic only, leave OFF for normal play. <LINE> When ON, every right-click prints what the mod found to the console: which objects the click produced, what they resolved to, and whether a barricade was located. <LINE> Look in console.txt in your Zomboid folder for lines starting [PPO]. <LINE> Use this if a barricade shows no 'Break Off Barricade' option and you want to know why.

Subtracted when the barricade is nailed to the FAR face of the door or window - you are working blind through the frame. <LINE> This is the usual case when breaking into a building, since barricades are put up from the inside. <LINE> Set 0 to make either side equally easy.

Subtracted from the barricade success chance on metal sheet and metal bar barricades. <LINE> Default 10, kept low on purpose: most of what makes metal hard is that it takes several hits (see 'metal hits to shift a panel'), so a big penalty on top of that stacks into a brick wall. <LINE> Minimum chance is still 5%%.
Barricade: metal hits to shift a panel

How many successful hits it takes to beat a metal sheet or a set of metal bars off the frame. <LINE> Default 2: the first buckles the panel, the second tears it away. The panel visibly dents in between, and the whole job is queued from one right-click. <LINE> Set 1 for the old all-or-nothing behaviour. <LINE> A panel zombies have already damaged needs fewer hits.

Barricade noise as a percentage of pry noise, before the global noise multiplier is applied. <LINE> Default 120: splintering wood and shrieking nails are the loudest thing this mod does. <LINE> Stacks multiplicatively with 'Noise radius multiplier'.

Chance that a plank torn off a barricade survives in one piece and lands in your inventory, along with some nails. <LINE> A salvaged plank keeps the damage the barricade had taken. <LINE> Metal sheets and metal bars are never salvageable - they come off bent. <LINE> Set 0 to destroy everything.

When ON, a door or window lock forced with a PRY TOOL is destroyed and can never be re-locked. <LINE> When OFF (default) the door simply becomes unlocked and a key still works on it. <LINE> This option governs pry tools only - bolt cutters always destroy the lock.
Pry: success chance per Strength point (%%)
Success chance of a PRY TOOL attempt is Strength x this value. <LINE> Default 10 means Strength 1 = 10%%, Strength 5 = 50%%, Strength 10 = 100%%. <LINE> The result is always clamped to 5-100%%.
Cut: allow bolt cutters on vehicle doors and hoods

OFF by default: a car door hides its lock inside the door skin and the hood release is a cable, so there is nothing to get the jaws around. <LINE> ON: 'Cut Open Door' and 'Cut Open Hood' appear on vehicles and behave like the trunk case - no condition damage, lock destroyed.
Cut: success chance per Strength point (%%)
Success chance of a BOLT CUTTER attempt is Strength x this value. <LINE> Default 10 means Strength 1 = 10%%, Strength 10 = 100%%. <LINE> The result is always clamped to 5-100%%.

Subtracted from the bolt cutter success chance on armoured / metal doors and garage doors. <LINE> Default 0: metal is not a hard target for bolt cutters, you are cutting the padlock, not levering the frame. <LINE> Minimum chance is still 5%% if you raise it.

Bolt cutter noise as a percentage of pry noise, before the global noise multiplier is applied. <LINE> Default 60: quieter than a crowbar but still loud enough to pull nearby zombies. <LINE> Stacks multiplicatively with 'Noise radius multiplier'.

Master switch for tearing barricades off doors and windows with a hammer, crowbar, tire iron or axe. <LINE> When OFF no 'Break Off Barricade' option appears anywhere and the server rejects the attempt. <LINE> Note vanilla Build 42 has no other way to remove a barricade, so turning this off makes every barricade permanent.
Master switch for everything bolt cutters do in this mod. <LINE> When OFF no 'Cut Open ...' option appears anywhere and the server rejects cut attempts. <LINE> Locks already cut stay cut.

Subtracted from the pry success chance on armoured / metal doors and garage doors. <LINE> Applied after the Strength roll, minimum chance is still 5%%. <LINE> Set 0 to make metal no harder than wood for crowbars.
Scales the world noise emitted by every attempt, success or failure, for both tool classes. <LINE> 100 = default loudness, 0 = completely silent, 300 = three times the radius.

ON (default): only items carrying the proper vanilla item tag qualify. <LINE> Pry = crowbar or prybar tag. Cut = boltcutters tag. <LINE> OFF: falls back to a small item-type list as well, so tag-less modded tools still work. <LINE> Wire cutters and metal snips never qualify either way.
Pry: vehicle part damage on success (%%)
Condition lost by a vehicle door / trunk / hood part when it is successfully PRIED open. <LINE> Set 0 for damage-free prying. <LINE> Bolt cutters never apply this.
